earnings.title: EX-99.1 PRESS RELEASE DATED NOVEMBER 4, 2026
highlights: Grew GAAP Net Income 7% and Adjusted EBITDA 17% y/y
Revenue grew 12%, driven by B2B, which grew 23%.
GAAP net income increased 7% while Adjusted Net Income grew 19%.
Diluted GAAP earnings per share increased 15% while Adjusted EPS increased 24%.
Total Gross Bookings grew 11%, while B2B Gross Bookings grew 19% and B2C Gross Bookings grew 7%.

quotes.text: We exceeded the high end of our guidance in the quarter, reflecting resilient travel demand and strong execution.
quotes.by: Ariane Gorin, CEO of Expedia Group

outlook: Exceeded guidance with 11% Gross Bookings and 12% revenue growth y/y

items.heading: We operate in an intensely competitive global environment and we may be unable to compete successfully with our current or future competitors.
Declines or disruptions in the travel industry could adversely affect our business and financial performance.
Our business depends on our relationships with travel suppliers and other B2B partners.
Our business could be negatively affected by changes in search engine algorithms and dynamics or other traffic-generating arrangements.
We work closely with various business partners and rely on third-parties for many systems and services, and therefore could be harmed by their activities.
Our international operations involve additional risks and our exposure to these risks will increase as our business expands globally.
